nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Facial Fuel Energizing Face Wash

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers say the gel cleanses without over-drying, though one felt it stopped controlling shine well before the next wash.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who names combination, breakout-prone skin as her main issue found it cleaned well without triggering dryness or new breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers describe it as gentle and non-irritating, but one developed a reaction after repeated use and stopped, and a couple of others flag the menthol scent as something to watch near the eyes.
segments.dry: A structured review that rates fit by skin type flags this wash as more likely to be drying for dry or sensitive skin and suggests a patch test first, and a few other reviewers note skin can feel stripped without a moisturizer straight after.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with oily or combination skin, say the wash does not dry out or strip the skin and describe it as hydrating; a minority, including a review aimed specifically at dry or sensitive skin, warn it can feel stripping, especially with twice-daily or nighttime use.
concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation or reaction, but one developed a reaction after about five uses and had to stop.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers, including one who calls her skin breakout-prone, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts after switching to this wash; none report new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One oily-skin reviewer says it clears oil with a comfortable, non-stripping feel; another with the same skin type found it cleansed well but did not keep oil at bay for long.
concerns.aging: A single long-term user felt her skin looked younger and more refreshed after adopting the wash as a daily one-pump routine; no other reviewer comments on fine lines or firmness.

aspects.libelle: Lather feels thinner, formula seems changed
Economical, small amount goes a long way

extraits.texte: I used this for 10 years, it was the best. But they recently changed the formula, and now it's about as effective as blue water. It doesn't foam anymore, it's not a gel anymore, and it doesn't clean anymore.

I've always been a fan of Kiehls. I tried this face wash with high hopes of loving it due to its ingredients. Unfortunately, my skin did not love it. I got a small reaction after my 5th try. I had to stop using the wash. My skin is very sensitive. This face wash was just not for me

I have oily skin and it didn't dry out too much. It didn't combat the oil for very long though. I have used it as a nice alternative to some of my foaming face washes for a quick morning wash. Overall, it wasn't bad but I probably wouldn't buy the product.

I have mixed feelings about the facial fuel wash. It does dry your skin out and you can feel it in your hands before you even begin to wash your face. You definitely want to follow up with your moisturizer afterwards. Nonetheless, It does clean your skin though. It is lightweight and lathers nicely. If you miss a spot when washing your face, you'll be able to tell as your skin will look matte and then shiny anywhere you missed a spot. This is not scent-free and does have a mint fragrance to it so if you have sensitive skin keep this in mind. The scent also helps give you that fresh, clean feeling if you use it at the start of your day. If you have had a long day out and about, this is a good face wash to help wind down in the late afternoon/evening but not one I would use at night time or multiple times per day as it can be too drying so you need to make sure to follow up with the rest of your skincare routine to avoid waking up with a really oily face the next day. I do think it's a good face wash but not one I would see myself using all the time but rather on occasion. I would recommend to others others based on their needs.

### Review of Kiehl's Facial Fuel Face Wash **Texture and Scent**: The gel-like texture lathers well and has a refreshing, mildly minty scent due to menthol. **Key Ingredients**: - **Caffeine**: Energizes the skin. - **Menthol**: Provides a cooling effect. - **Vitamin E**: Protects and hydrates the skin. **Performance**: It effectively removes dirt and oil, leaving the skin feeling clean and refreshed. Best for normal to oily skin types. **Packaging**: The sturdy tube design is functional and easy to use. **Pros**: - Energizing and refreshing - Effective at cleansing - Contains beneficial ingredients **Cons**: - May be drying for sensitive or dry skin - Menthol might irritate some users ### Additional Insights **How does this product compare to other products you've tried?** It stands out for its energizing properties and unique ingredients. However, it may not be as gentle as some other face washes. **What are some benefits of owning this product?** - Refreshes and energizes the skin. - Effective cleansing without stripping the skin. **Would you buy this product?** Yes, especially for its refreshing effects in the morning. **Would you recommend this product to your friends or family?** Yes, particularly for those with normal to oily skin. For those with dry or sensitive skin, a sample test is recommended.

I have used a LOT of face washes. I am prone to breakouts, and also my skin likes to dry out- fun combo. This wash has a very light scent which is nice and fresh. It feels like it leaves my skin clean, and lathers nicely. So far, it has not dried my skin out which is excellent. Overall, it is perfect for my combination/problematic skin and checks all the boxes. Thank you Kiehl's for letting me try it out, I will definitely use this one again and again!

I typically take great care of my skin. I use mostly organic products to wash and moisturize, but was becoming very dry from the last product I used from another brand. I decided to try the Facial Fuel Wash for one week and was BLOWN away at how hydrating and cleansing the product was. Even with irritable skin, I had no issues at all. Keeping this one stocked throughout the rest of the summer/ fall for sure!!
